catalogQueryDefinitions.sql: SELECT relname, relkind, pg_get_userbyid(relowner), relrowsecurity, relforcerowsecurity, obj_description(oid) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='users'

SELECT attnum, attname, format_type(atttypid,atttypmod), attnotnull, pg_get_expr(adbin,adrelid), attidentity, attgenerated, col_description(c.oid,attnum) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid=a.attrelid AND ad.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='users' AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped ORDER BY attnum
SELECT conname, contype, pg_get_constraintdef(oid), confdeltype, confupdtype FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.users'::regclass

SELECT indexname, indexdef, indisunique, indisprimary FROM pg_indexes i JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname=i.indexname JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid=c.oid WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='users'

SELECT polname, polcmd, polpermissive, polroles, pg_get_expr(polqual,polrelid), pg_get_expr(polwithcheck,polrelid) FROM pg_policy pol JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=pol.polrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='users'
SELECT grantee, privilege_type, is_grantable FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='users'
SELECT tgname, pg_get_triggerdef(oid) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.users'::regclass AND NOT tgisinternal

SELECT seq.relname FROM pg_class seq JOIN pg_depend d ON d.objid=seq.oid AND d.deptype='a' JOIN pg_class tbl ON tbl.oid=d.refobjid JOIN pg_namespace tn ON tn.oid=tbl.relnamespace WHERE seq.relkind='S' AND tn.nspname='public' AND tbl.relname='users'
